title: Schwab Position Market Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=schwab:position market_value_usd=*
| stats sum(market_value_usd) as total_value, avg(market_value_usd) as avg_value by symbol
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks symbol values by total and average market value across Schwab position events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `market_value_usd` values for each Schwab position event and review total and average market value by symbol.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total market value.
grandmaExplanation: It charts which symbol shows the biggest market value numbers in your Schwab position data.
